# PHP's own sqlite corpus: the tests that fail under the shim and PASS under
# stock sqlite. CI measures this on every run against the php-src tag matching
# the runner's interpreter. ubuntu-latest's php-cli is 8.5.4 as of the run
# that added the PHP 8.5 groups below: 153 top-level sqlite tests collected,
# 297 executed once subclasses and the shared PDO suite are counted. Stock
# sqlite fails zero of them. The groups before "PHP 8.5 explain mode" were
# first measured on php-8.3.6 and still fail on 8.5, except
# pdo_fetch_func_001.phpt, which passes on both engines under 8.5 and is
# not listed.
#
# A test reached through that redirect is reported under the directory that
# redirected to it, so the four bug_* entries below name ext/pdo_sqlite/tests
# while the files live in ext/pdo/tests. That is run-tests' naming, not a typo.
#
# One test SKIPS under the shim and runs under stock sqlite:
# ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_42589.phpt, whose SKIPIF greps PRAGMA
# compile_options for ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA. We do not advertise it, so the
# test declines to run. CI prints it every time rather than letting a skip
# pass for agreement.
#
# This list exists so a NEW failure is visible. It is not a target to keep at
# zero by deletion — a line removed without the test passing is a lie the next
# person inherits.
#
# Classified by inspection. None of these returns wrong DATA silently: every
# one is a refusal, a message difference, a missing feature or metadata. That
# is the property worth defending, and the reason this list is tolerable.
#
#   feature not implemented — real work, tracked separately
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/gh9032.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/gh9032.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_25_create_aggregate.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_38_backup.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_40_setauthorizer.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_trampoline_create_aggregate.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_trampoline_create_collation.phpt
#
#   rigid typing: mpedb REFUSES a comparison sqlite coerces. Loud, not silent.
ext/sqlite3/tests/bug73068.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/bug73333.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/gh20699.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_71885.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_72368.phpt
#
#   error text differs, both engines refuse
#   (four left here when the authorizer stopped rewriting compile errors and
#   the duplicate-table refusal learned to name its table)
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug38334.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_34630.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_36798.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/common.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/pdo_sqlite_filename_uri.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/pdo_sqlite_transaction.phpt
#
#   (extended result codes used to sit here — sqlite3_extended_result_codes()
#   was a no-op, so sqlite3_errcode() gave 19 where sqlite gives 1555. Fixed;
#   both tests pass. Left as a note because "coarser, never wrong" is the kind
#   of gap that stays put until someone writes down what it costs.)
#
#   PHP 8.5 explain mode. The shim switches it (`sqlite3_stmt_explain`):
#   EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN is the four-column plan, and a bare EXPLAIN is
#   mpedb's plan text. These tests assert sqlite's VDBE opcode names
#   (Init, String8, Insert, …) and the detail string "SCAN t". mpedb has
#   no VDBE listing, and its plan text is its own. Both pass on stock sqlite.
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_explain.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdo_sqlite_getsetattr_explain.phpt
#
#   PHP 8.5 column names. sqlite keeps the source text of the expression
#   (`strtoupper("test")`, `S(a)`). mpedb renders its own (`strtoupper('test')`,
#   `s(a)`). The values under those names match: TEST, and the two aggregates
#   1,3,6,10,14 and -1,-3,-6,-10,-14.
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdo_sqlite_createafunction_trampoline.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdo_sqlite_createaggregate_trampoline.phpt
#
#   Collation callback count. ORDER BY s COLLATE NAT on a1/a10/a2 calls the
#   collation once more than sqlite does. The first row is still a1.
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdo_sqlite_createcollation_trampoline.phpt
#
#   One writer lock. A deferred transaction already locks the database, so a
#   second connection's BEGIN IMMEDIATE is "database is locked" (code 5) where
#   sqlite still says it is not. Immediate and exclusive contention is the
#   same code 5; sqlite reports code 6 and distinguishes "database table is
#   locked" from "database schema is locked: main".
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdo_sqlite_transaction_mode.phpt
#
#   Authorizer arguments, not a wrong row. SQLITE_SELECT is reported with
#   database name "main" where sqlite passes none (`,,,`). A second READ of
#   the same column is not raised. DROP TABLE is one DROP_TABLE action;
#   sqlite also walks sqlite_master (DELETE, READ of tbl_name and type,
#   UPDATE of rootpage). Those catalog steps are sqlite's, and the shim does
#   not invent them.
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/subclasses/pdosqlite_setauthorizer.phpt
#
#   Invalid UTF-8 SQL. gh13952 quotes byte 0x80 and selects the literal back.
#   mpedb refuses the statement: "SQL is not valid UTF-8". Loud, before any row.
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/gh13952.phpt
